test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneously spelt word is **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Revange**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Revenge**'. • It means** 'something that you do to punish somebody who has hurt you, made you suffer, etc.'** [(किसी से किसी बात का) बदला, प्रतिशोध (चोट के बदले चोट)] • Example: He made a fool of me and now I want to get my **revenge**. • ​Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Retort**: to reply quickly to what somebody says, in an angry or amusing way. [किसी की बात का तुरंत जवाब देना (चिढ़कर या विनोदी ढंग से)] • **Retrieve**: to get something back from the place where it was left or lost. [(किसी वस्‍तु को) पुनः प्राप्‍त करना (वहाँ से जहाँ वह छूटी या खोई थी)] • **Return**: to come or go back to a place. (कहीं पहुँचना या लौटना) 17f:T5e4, The erroneous part is** 'but he warn him'.**
